The created user has the permissions of an ordinary newly provisioned standard user in the target directory. CSV input cannot grant administrative permission or extra group membership.
A signed-in administrator who can create users in the target directory can submit imports when available. A signed-in administrator who lacks that authority in the target is refused.

If ordinary standard-user provisioning sends an invitation or activation notice, a committed imported user is eligible for the same notice. A rejected or failed attempt sends zero notices from the account creation.
A file of 1,048,577 bytes or more is refused for size and creates zero users. ... A file with 1,001 is refused for record count and creates zero users.
Submitting a zero-byte file or a recognized header with no data records creates zero users and reports that the file contains no users. ... A valid CSV containing one new user creates one user.
